title: THE FULL CONTROLS LEGEND NAMES A PLAYSTATION PAD TOO
why: The pad names build left one place out: the full controls list (H pressed twice) still said A, B, X, Y on a PlayStation pad. It goes through the same translation now.
now: The full controls list (H twice) also names a PlayStation pad in its own words.

edits.replacement: ctx.fillText(padB(k[0]),x+LH(6),cy);   // v16.xx: the pad in its own words
